fig02_dataset_statistics: BIDMC: record-level statistics, example spectra and autocorrelation (descriptive EDA, from analysed records).
fig03_raw_vs_filtered: BIDMC: raw versus causally filtered respiratory signal; dashed line is an offline-only zero-phase reference.
fig07_calibration_coverage: Empirical versus nominal central-interval coverage per forecast horizon (pooled test windows; subject-level CIs are in the tables).

fig12_roc_failure: ROC curves for predicting future tracking failure (predictive controller, D=300 ms).
fig13_pr_failure: Precision–recall curves for predicting future tracking failure (predictive controller, D=300 ms).
fig01_pipeline: Overall research pipeline (all robot results are simulations).
fig04_eda_power_spectra: Welch power spectra at native sampling rate for representative records; shaded = analysis passband (descriptive EDA).
fig05_forecasts_uncertainty: Ensemble forecasts with 95% Gaussian intervals at each horizon (bidmc15, normalised units).
fig06_error_vs_horizon: Forecast error versus horizon; markers = subject-level mean, bars = 95% bootstrap CI.
fig15_ablation: Ablations: controller ladder (left) and forecaster family under predictive control (right); SIMULATED tracking.
